Name: Bentleys Fast Food Useful Stuff
Author: BentleyTheModder1
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff9933]Bentley Playz[/color] [color=#ff4d4d]Fast Food[/color] [color=#ffffff]&[/color] [color=#4dd2ff]Useful Stuff[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#ffd24d]A new restaurant, new characters, new food, and plenty of questionable decisions![/color][/b][/size]

[size=5][b][color=#66ff66]NEW in 3.16: the Restaurant Kiosk is upgraded, now with an anti-theft system![/color][/b][/size][/center]

[line]

Welcome to Bentley's Fast Food & Useful Stuff! This mod adds a fully walk-in restaurant to Stardew Valley, complete with its own interior, ordering counter, dining booths, dessert corner, arcade, and even Bentley's bedroom.

The restaurant is located on the Bus Stop lawn, with an open, welcoming entrance and its own dirt path leading toward the road.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#66ff66]What's New (3.14 - 3.16.5)[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#ffd24d]The kiosk has been upgraded![/color][/b]

- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Portable Restaurant Kiosk[/color][/b]: take Bentley's menu with you. Place it anywhere on your farm (or indoors), tap it, and pick Desserts, Food or Seasonal.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Daily kiosk deals[/color][/b]: 10% off, up to 3 items per day, shared across Desserts, Food and Seasonal, and refreshed every morning.
- [b][color=#ff4d4d]Anti-theft system[/color][/b]: the kiosk now counts what actually lands in your bag, so nobody can sneak extra discounted items through.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]New picker menu[/color][/b]: choosing a shop now uses a menu styled like the game's own dialogue box. It works with touch, mouse, keyboard and controller, and closes with the X, Cancel, a tap outside, Esc, Back or B, and the phone's back button.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Easier to open[/color][/b]: tap or click anywhere on the kiosk, including its top half. No more tapping an empty tile above it, and no more getting stuck next to it on a phone.

[b][color=#ffd24d]More new stuff[/color][/b]

- [b][color=#66ff66]13 new food and drink items[/color][/b]: 5 breakfast items and 8 seasonal items, all new in this update. They're sold at the counter and the kiosk, and most give small buffs.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Counter menu[/color][/b]: use the ordering counter and Bentley asks what you'd like to see: Main Menu, Breakfast or Seasonal.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Breakfast menu[/color][/b]: five new items, served at the counter from 6 AM to 10 AM (and all day at the kiosk).
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Seasonal menu[/color][/b]: two items for each season, on sale only during their season.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Milkshake[/color][/b]: sold at Bentley's counter, and Bentley teaches you the recipe at 4 hearts.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]2-heart event[/color][/b]: reach 2 hearts with Bentley and he shows you the kiosk and teaches you how to craft it, with a letter following the next day.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]One mod, one DLL[/color][/b]: the Fast Food code, Bus Stop guard and kiosk are now all one file. All settings live in [b]Code/config.json[/b].
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Windex[/color][/b] is now a liked gift for Bentley. He thinks it's great for cleaning the windows.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]The Restaurant Kiosk[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#ffd24d]How to get it:[/color][/b] Reach 2 hearts with Bentley, then walk into the Bus Stop (6 AM to 10 PM). He shows you the kiosk and teaches you the recipe.

[b][color=#ffd24d]Crafting:[/color][/b] 50 Wood, 5 Iron Bars and 3 Refined Quartz.

[b][color=#ffd24d]Using it:[/color][/b] Tap, click or press the action button on it, then pick Desserts, Food or Seasonal. It takes up one tile, and you can pick it up again with an axe or pickaxe.

[b][color=#ffd24d]Kiosk deals:[/color][/b] 10% off, up to 3 items per day. The deals are shared by all your kiosks. The counter, the Dessert Corner and Gus's never give deals.

[size=4][b][color=#ff4d4d]Anti-Theft System[/color][/b][/size]

Only your remaining daily deals get the discount. Anything you buy beyond that is charged [b][color=#ff4d4d]full price[/color][/b] automatically, no matter how you buy it. For example, with 3 deals left, 10 French Fries cost 3 at 81g and 7 at the full 90g.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]New Characters[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#4dd2ff]Bentley[/color][/b]

Meet Bentley, the owner of the restaurant and a new villager in Stardew Valley!

- Birthday: Spring 12
- Has custom sprites and portraits.
- Has a winter outfit.
- Wears a hazmat suit during the Green Rain.
- Is not romanceable.
- Has his own daily schedule.
- Visits Gus's Stardrop Saloon in the evening.
- Has a 2-heart event and teaches you recipes as you get closer.

[b][color=#4dd2ff]Restaurant Robot[/color][/b]

Meet the Restaurant Robot, another new character who helps keep the restaurant running!

- Has custom dialogue and a portrait.
- Greets customers at the restaurant.
- Helps cover the ordering counter in the evening.
- Cannot receive gifts.
- Does not have a friendship heart system.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Restaurant Features[/color][/b][/size]

- A fully walk-in restaurant.
- A dedicated ordering counter with a Main / Breakfast / Seasonal menu.
- Dining booths and chairs that can be sat on.
- A dessert corner with its own selection of treats.
- An arcade room featuring vanilla Prairie King and Junimo Kart.
- Bentley's bedroom behind the kitchen staff door.
- Restaurant lighting and interior decorations.
- A welcoming exterior entrance with an open fence area.
- A dedicated dirt path leading toward the road.
- A portable Restaurant Kiosk with daily deals.
- A welcome letter delivered when you begin.
- Update announcements when the mod is updated.

[b][color=#66ff66]The restaurant is open 24 hours. The entrance and ordering counter never close.[/color][/b]

[size=5][b][color=#ff4d4d]Windex Warning[/color][/b][/size]

Windex is a fictional joke item included in this mod. It is not real glass cleaner.

Drinking the in-game Windex or eating the Windex Swirl Cone causes health damage by default. The damage will never reduce your health below 1.

You can adjust or disable the damage in [b]Code/config.json[/b]:

- WindexDrinkDamage
- WindexSwirlConeDamage

Set either value to 0 to disable its corresponding damage.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Character Schedules[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#4dd2ff]Bentley[/color][/b]

Bentley follows the same schedule in Spring, including rainy days:

- 6:10 AM: Restaurant ordering counter, tile (16, 4).
- 6:00 PM: Gus's Stardrop Saloon, tile (24, 17).
- 9:00 PM: Goes home and sleeps in his bedroom, tile (10, 5).

[b][color=#4dd2ff]Restaurant Robot[/color][/b]

The Restaurant Robot also follows the same schedule in Spring, including rainy days:

- 6:00 AM: Bentley's bedroom, tile (2, 9).
- 6:00 PM: Restaurant ordering counter, tile (15, 4).
- Remains at the restaurant counter until the day ends.

The Robot takes over counter coverage at 6:00 PM, while Bentley handles the counter during the daytime.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Arcade Room[/color][/b][/size]

The restaurant includes an arcade room with two familiar vanilla games:

- Prairie King
- Junimo Kart

Both arcade machines are included in the restaurant interior.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]How the Mod Works[/color][/b][/size]

This mod uses two main components:

- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Content Patcher:[/color][/b] Handles custom content, maps, and game assets.
- [b][color=#4dd2ff]Custom SMAPI DLL:[/color][/b] One single DLL that provides the counter menu, the kiosk and its anti-theft system, door locking, Windex damage, update announcements and the Bus Stop guard.

Both components are included as part of the combined mod installation.

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Configuration[/color][/b][/size]

All settings are in [b]Code/config.json[/b]:

- WindexDrinkDamage / WindexSwirlConeDamage
- BreakfastStartTime / BreakfastEndTime
- KioskDealsPerDay (default 3)
- KioskDiscountPercent (default 10)
- DevLogging
- BusStopGuard options

Copy your old config into the new Code folder when updating, or type [b]bentley_reload_config[/b] in the SMAPI console to re-read it in game.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#ffd24d]Requirements:[/color][/b]

- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later within the 1.6 series (other versions have not been tested).
- SMAPI 4.1.10 or later.
- Content Patcher 2.6.0 or later.

[b][color=#ffd24d]Compatibility Notes:[/color][/b]

- The restaurant has support for the Bus Stop map.
- The restaurant also appears in the Ice Festival version of the Bus Stop.
- This mod should be compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.
- Works on Android with SMAPI (touch controls supported).
- Other mods that modify the Bus Stop may conflict.
- Festival support can be enabled through the EnableFestivals configuration option. This feature is experimental and disabled by default.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

1. Make sure SMAPI and Content Patcher are installed.
2. Remove older versions of the following folders from your Mods directory:
- BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff
- BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff_SMAPI
- Any old separate Kiosk mod folder (the kiosk is now part of this mod)
3. Extract the combined mod folder, [b]BentleyPlayz FastFoodUsefulStuff[/b], directly into your Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley and check the SMAPI console for errors.

[b][color=#ffd24d]Important upgrade notes:[/color][/b]

- Save outside the restaurant before updating because the interior layout may change.
- The old Farm building from versions before 3.0.0 should be demolished.
- Older furniture items may appear as error items because the furniture shop was removed in version 3.13.0.
- Existing Bus Stop bushes, weeds, and twigs may remain after installation.
- If you used the old separate Kiosk mod, remove it. Your kiosk daily-deal save data carries over.

[color=#66ff66]Your save files remain compatible with the updated mod.[/color]
